set.body:
Scope: modules/mvpa-dataset generic prediction and SoftLda split; ../mvpa4s optional predictive module.

Deliverable: Move generic preparation/fitting/validation/tuning adapters and separate fit-dependent SoftLda composition into ScalaFIM integration.

Acceptance:
- Predictive module builds without dataset/response/fit types from ScalaFIM.
- Training-only preparation, split/exposure and held-out prediction behavior preserve existing JVM/JS test evidence.
- Generic predictive implementation exists once; fit-specific composition uses public adapters downstream.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U4: Extract reusable Alder predictive adapters
